data.narrative:
Field AI, a Series B AI & Software company founded by Ali Agha and Shayegan Omidshafiei, carries a current post-money valuation of $2.0B following $405M in total capital raised. The valuation is assessed against a universe of 9 comparable companies: 8 private AI & Software firms at same or adjacent stages, plus 1 public comparable (Palantir). The peer set includes Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B, Series C), and Together AI ($8.3B, Series C).

Two valuation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to next-stage step-ups, yielding $3.8B. Peer-median triangulation across 7 same-sector comparables produces a $10.0B implied value, with the peer set ranging from $3.25B to $39.0B. These methods anchor a valuation range of $3.2B (low) to $11.5B (high), with a median implied value of $6.9B.

The current $2.0B valuation sits below both methodological outputs, suggesting modest upside in a normalized Series B-to-C progression. Key uncertainties include stage-specific volatility in frontier AI valuations, heterogeneity in peer business models and burn profiles, and the nascent nature of comparable exit multiples in this sector.
